[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I must implant a new circulation[XENO:n ]
system for her immune functions.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]
But we have one problem.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I don't have a Piezoelectric Unit, which is[XENO:n ]
required to control such a system.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]As long as she remains on this bed,[XENO:n ]
the life support machine can compensate.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

But to move around freely, she[XENO:n ]
must have the Piezoelectric Unit.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

The same unit is used in Mechon, so[XENO:n ]
if you were to find some Mechon parts...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Well, outside of the village, at the[XENO:n ]
base of Digit 5, there is a beach.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Debris from above washes ashore there.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

You might be able to find one[XENO:n ]
among the Mechon wreckage.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]We'll take a look.[XENO:n ]
The beach at the base of Digit 5, right?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Yes. It gives off a faint red glow so[XENO:n ]
it might be easier to find at night.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
